title: Bengal Unfolded
tagline: History is not only the past, it is still shaping us
intro: From 1947 to 2024, this is a journey through unresolved questions, resistance, and the pursuit of justice.
timelineSubheading: From partition to contemporary civic demands, each chapter sets the stage for the next.
whyJourneyMattersBody: These five moments are not only history—they shape our identity, rights, and collective future.
